name: Demo G6: Add-Like Redline Receptacle
description: Exercise an add-like redline operation using an explicit receptacle-like modeled family-instance target with strict created-id, type, visibility, visual-gate, and cleanup evidence.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view, level, and receptacle family/type that can be safely placed and deleted.
If the model lacks a host-compatible receptacle type, keep this task out of the local live override until discovery finds one.
success_criteria: A disposable receptacle family instance id is created in the model.
The native create result returns family/type/name evidence matching the requested receptacle symbol.
The created receptacle id is visible in the post-add visible-element inventory.
A deterministic add visual gate artifact passes using post-change capture evidence.
The created receptacle is cleaned up with native dry-run and applied delete effect evidence.
failure_criteria: The receptacle is not created or is created as a different requested type.
The post-add visible-element inventory does not contain the created receptacle id.
The add visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
The cleanup delete dry-run/apply omits the receptacle id from effect evidence.
grader_notes: This task makes receptacles a first-class add-like benchmark instead of relying only on the generic family-instance task.
Text-note or tag evidence must not satisfy this task; it requires modeled family-instance proof.
